why: D1 in tables and JSON: the map
cases: suite: the first n per family of suite_split/map_A8_v1's cases (read_write's selection; BL/BR/RL/RR and BLR/BRL share scenes); countries: the first n per family of control_split/map_v1's
sets:
Position sets, per prompt, from character offsets of the generator's own sentences (asserted to tile the context):
  bind_bridge    the binding statement that states the bridge (bound families: the queried person's)
  bridge_word    its bridge-entity token(s) alone
  bind_other     the other persons' binding statements (in B families C also changes X's owner's)
  lookup_bridge  the bridge's lookup statement ("The cow's locker is 5."; BLR its friend row, BRL its legs row; none
                 for countries, whose capital is recalled)
  lookup_x       X's lookup statement (the row C's re-binding points the question to: a copy at the bridge's row
                 alone cannot redirect the lookup)
  context        every context token (all statements: the statement route's ceiling)
  question       suite_split's question group, exactly (the question's tokens after C's changed ones through the end)
  q_words        question minus final
  final          the template after the user turn: <|im_end|>, the assistant header, the empty think block, "Answer:"
For RL, RR and countries R, C changes only the cue in the question, so every statement position precedes C's change:
copying C there is an exact no-op (a built-in check). O's change (the lockers / friends / rows / holders of X and Z)
also comes after every binding statement in the suite, so O's copy at the binding statements is exactly zero there.
read: suite_split's: one forward of the edited clean prompt (a digit's space token appended), the top token's role (b: X's answer, A: the bridge's, other), ld = logit(b) - logit(A), frac = (ld - ld_clean) / (ld_C - ld_clean)
question: Where, by position set and layer, does each family carry its bridge (lens-free)?

sources.cf: C's block output copied at the set (AddRows of h_C - h_clean)
sources.off: O's, the same way, where O's delta is non-zero
sources.rand: C's delta with each row replaced by a random direction at that row's norm (null_rows, seed 0 + 1e9 x set index + 1e5 x case index + layer)

sanity.identity: AddRows of zero at every position (layers: the first and last map layer): no change
sanity.all0: C's delta at every position at the first map layer: reproduces C's read
sanity.zero_cells: cells whose positions all precede the first changed token are verified exactly zero and skipped; for the first 5 cases of each cue-only family the zero C copies at the statements are read anyway (exact no-ops)
sanity.validation: 8 greedy tokens for every edit of the first 10 cases per family

decision.transit: C's copy gives X's answer in >= 50% of cases and its Wilson 95% lower bound is above the upper bound of every control's change rate (O where non-zero, rand); zero-delta cases count as unchanged
decision.handoff: per family and statement set, the last transit layer; per family, the first layer at which the question set is in transit
decision.fixed: before the 27B run (the 0.8B smoke checks the code path only)
